title: Smoothie Mod
description: Smoothie mod eliminates teleporting and choppy movement experienced by laggy players and those with unstable internet by changing how the game interpolates their position.
body: Smoothie Mod removes the choppy, stuttering movement you see from laggy players. When someone's connection is jittery or their position updates arrive irregularly, vanilla Minecraft makes them look like they're teleporting and rubber-banding around. Smoothie Mod fixes that by adapting how their movement is interpolated so it stays fluid.
